existing_cooperation.title: Cambodia-China University of Technology and Science inaugurated in Phnom Penh
existing_cooperation.summary: Nanjing Vocational University of Industry Technology and the Federation of Khmer Chinese in Cambodia established Cambodia-China University of Technology and Science in Phnom Penh. It is described as China's first overseas applied technology university for vocational education and offers dual China-Cambodia degree pathways. This record is coded for Cambodia, China with a existing cooperation focus. The source is China Daily / Study China, published on 2024-01-02, and the relevant specialties are new energy power generation, automotive service, network engineering, e-commerce, modern logistics management, tourism management. Specific evidence recorded from the source includes: 1) Inauguration ceremony held in Phnom Penh on 2023-12-20. 2) Six undergraduate majors listed: new energy power generation, automotive service, network engineering, e-commerce, modern logistics management, tourism management. 3) MOE Vice Minister Wu Yan said China had established 19 overseas educational institutions and projects in Cambodia. 4) Jiangsu universities trained nearly 1,800 Cambodian students over the previous five years. articles.title: SVCIT Innovation Center (Vietnam)
articles.summary: Founded on September 29, 2022, SVCIT Innovation Center (Vietnam) is an overseas training base jointly sponsored by Sichuan Vocational College of Information Technology, Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HUTECH) and Suzhou Secote Precision Electronic Co., Ltd. It serves as an overseas exchange platform for Chinese vocational education to serve Chinese enterprises going global and support Belt and Road development.
institutions: Sichuan Vocational College of Information Technology
Ho Chi Minh City University of Technology (HUTECH)

articles.title: Wuhan Electric Power Technical College Indonesia Green Energy Talent Development Base
articles.summary: Founded on December 2, 2025, the Wuhan Electric Power Technical College Indonesia Green Energy Talent Development Base is a joint initiative established by Wuhan Electric Power Technical College (WHETC), PT.CCEPC, and Politeknik Negeri Ujung Pandang (PNUP). The base focuses on cultivating high-level technical professionals for Indonesia's green and electric-power industries through training, curriculum development, and faculty exchanges.

articles.title: China-ASEAN Rail Transit Engineering Vocational Education Alliance (REVEA)
articles.summary: China-ASEAN Rail Transit Engineering Vocational Education Alliance (China-ASEAN REVEA) was established on May 19, 2018, with 68 international and domestic member institutions. The alliance aims to promote the development of rail transit in ASEAN countries through resource sharing, talent demand forecasting, training platform development, and skill competition organization.

articles.title: GTVTC & SEAMEO TED China-ASEAN Transport Training Center
articles.summary: The China-ASEAN Transport Training Center addresses the need for power sector professionals across ASEAN by sharing China's two decades of experience in power sector development. Established under the China-ASEAN Energy Power Vocational Education Group (CAEPVEG), the center provides training resources and expertise to support regional energy and transportation infrastructure development.

articles.title: CHINA (GUANGXI) - SEA TVET PROGRAM
articles.summary: In January 2023, the Department of Education of the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region signed an agreement with SEAMEO TED to jointly build the China (Guangxi) - SEA TVET Program in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. This is the first overseas training centre under this brand, jointly operated by Guangxi Department of Education and Cambodian institutions, serving broader Southeast Asian region.
institutions: Department of Education of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region

articles.title: ASEAN-China Smart Education Institute in Colourful Guizhou
articles.summary: The ASEAN-China Smart Education Institute in Colourful Guizhou is the first national-level international education cooperation service platform for ASEAN and Belt and Road countries to implement the China-ASEAN Education Action Plan. It promotes educational exchanges, drives collaboration in higher and vocational education, and explores cross-border digital education applications with micro-credentials and credit bank services.

articles.title: Sichuan Vocational College IT Innovation Center Thailand
articles.summary: Sichuan Vocational College of Information Technology established an overseas training and innovation base in Thailand to promote vocational education cooperation between China and Thailand, focusing on IT and digital technology skills development for ASEAN workforce.
institutions: Sichuan Vocational College of Information Technology

articles.title: China-ASEAN Digital TVET Cooperation Platform
articles.summary: The China-ASEAN Digital TVET Cooperation Platform was established to promote digital vocational education cooperation between China and ASEAN countries, providing online courses, virtual training resources, and digital competency certification for vocational students and workers across the region.

articles.title: SEAMEO VOCTECH Regional Centre (Brunei)
articles.summary: The SEAMEO Regional Centre for Vocational and Technical Education and Training (SEAMEO VOCTECH) was established on 28 August 1990 in Brunei Darussalam. It is mandated to assist SEAMEO-member countries to identify and solve common problems in technical vocational education and training, undertaking activities in professional development, research, consultancy, and information dissemination.

articles.title: SEAMEO TED Technical Education Development Centre
articles.summary: SEAMEO Regional Centre for Technical Education Development (SEAMEO TED) was established on 25 July 2017 to assist SEAMEO Member Countries in identifying educational problems and finding alternative solutions for sustainable human resource development through technical education. It partners with China on the China-ASEAN 2030 TVET Flagship Courses Sharing Initiative.

articles.title: SEA Vocational-Technical High School Network
articles.summary: The SEA Vocational-Technical High School Network was established by SEAMEO TED to serve as a forum for school leaders, experts, researchers, academics, and stakeholders in vocational-technical education and training at secondary level from SEAMEO Member Countries. The network enables partnership, feedback, and input for promoting quality and relevant technical education across Southeast Asia.

articles.title: China-ASEAN 2030 TVET Flagship Courses Sharing Initiative
articles.summary: In response to the China-ASEAN 2030 TVET Flagship Courses Sharing Initiative initiated by SEAMEO TED, Chinese vocational colleges are developing and sharing international digital flagship courses that meet the needs of Chinese enterprises' international capacity cooperation and align with industry development plans of Southeast Asian countries including Vietnam, Thailand, Myanmar, Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, and Brunei.
institutions: Sichuan Vocational College of Information Technology

articles.title: GO STUDY GLOBAL EDUCATION - International Education Consultation
articles.summary: GO STUDY GLOBAL EDUCATION, based in Chengdu and Nanning city in China, focuses on international education consultation making study abroad accessible and affordable. Since 2014, they have established cooperation with many Chinese universities connecting them with overseas universities, facilitating student mobility programs, teachers' overseas training, and international academic conferences across ASEAN countries.

articles.title: ASEAN-China Education Cooperation Platform - Thailand Digital Education Initiative
articles.summary: The ASEAN-China Smart Education Institute in Colourful Guizhou promotes educational exchanges and cooperation between China, ASEAN, and Belt and Road countries, driving collaboration in higher and vocational education. Thailand participates as a key ASEAN partner in this national-level international education cooperation service platform implementing the China-ASEAN Education Action Plan.

articles.title: Sichuan Vocational College IT Innovation Center Thailand - AI Courses for ASEAN
articles.summary: Sichuan Vocational College of Information Technology has launched four international digital courses under the AI technology application professional standard, including Machine Learning, Introduction to Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, and Data Annotation. These courses are promoted by SEAMEO TED to vocational institutions across ASEAN including Thailand, contributing to technical talent cultivation.
institutions: Sichuan Vocational College of Information Technology
